About the Role 
 We are looking for a Tech Lead Full Stack Developer with French to drive technical excellence across a team responsible for developing and maintaining enterprise-grade applications. This role combines hands-on technical expertise, architecture involvement, technical leadership, and close collaboration with development and business stakeholders.
 Responsibilities 
 • Define and validate technical solutions and architectures
 • Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams
 • Conduct code reviews and promote engineering best practices
 • Support architectural and technical decision-making
 • Ensure scalability, performance, and maintainability of solutions
 • Coordinate with development, cloud, and integration teams
 • Contribute to complex incident analysis and resolution
 • Maintain technical standards and architecture documentation
 Required Skills 
 • Strong experience with Java, Spring Boot, and Angular
 • Technical leadership experience
 • Software architecture and solution design expertise
 • Experience with code reviews and development standards
 • Strong understanding of enterprise application environments
 • French language skills
 Nice to Have 
 • Azure Cloud
 • Data Integration
 • Distributed Systems
 • Production Support experience
 • Enterprise Application Landscapes
 Environment 
 • Java / Spring Boot
 • Angular
 • SQL Databases
 • Azure Cloud
 • Enterprise Applications
 • Cross-functional Technical Teams
 • Large-Scale International Projects
 Profile 
 • Senior technical professional with leadership capabilities
 • Able to mentor developers and guide technical decisions
 • Strong architecture and problem-solving mindset
 • Comfortable balancing hands-on development and team leadership
 • Focused on quality, scalability, and long-term maintainability of solutions
 What do we offer? 
25 holiday days per year.
1066 RON monthly budget in Benefit Online Platform.
Life Insurance cover.
The employees working on bank holidays will be benefitting either of a paid day off in the next 30 days + 100% of the hourly base salary for that specific day OR 200% of the hourly base salary for that specific day.
Reimbursement for eyeglasses – max 1500 RON to be claimed every 3 years.
Childbirth allowance of 7000 RON after 1 year in HCLTech.
Internal trainings and certifications.
 Who are we? 
 We are HCLTech, one of the fastest-growing large tech companies in the world and home to 225,000+ people across 60 countries, supercharging progress through industry-leading capabilities centered around Digital, Engineering and Cloud. The driving force behind that work, our people, are diverse, creative, and passionate, raising the bar for excellence on a regular basis.
